publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Scientific algorithmic chemical-identity teaching reconstruction, not a source structure image, measured conformer, assay result, biomarker result, treatment recommendation, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: Current PubChem, ChEBI, LPSN, NCBI Taxonomy, and local source-resolution records define identity and conservative representation boundaries only; no source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Only exact neutral Serotonin is cleared for one immutable heavy-atom connectivity call. The stale source-free Parvimonas route, unversioned shared-pathobiont analysis, and source-free obsolete overview fail category, evidence, stable-subject, or governed-dataset gates and receive no prompt marker or generation call.
promotionRule: Only a literal single-model output matching the frozen neutral Serotonin thirteen-heavy-atom graph, fully opaque pale field, and crop-safe requirements may proceed to exact-hash review. The other three routes remain non-public scientific holds.

routeDecisions.reason: Parvimonas is a current valid genus with P. micra as type species, but current LPSN lists four validly published correct child species while the local route calls it a single-species genus. The route is category other, has zero sources, and combines microorganism, cancer, biomarker, metal, virulence, and treatment claims. It cannot enter the microorganism morphology pipeline from this record.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Reclassify the route, update the genus subdivision and family/order claims, attach direct type-species and type-strain morphology and biosafety sources, reconcile unsupported cancer, biomarker, metal, virulence, and intervention claims, then repeat the microorganism morphology audit.

routeDecisions.reason: The route combines many taxa, conditions, enrichment directions, metal dependencies, mechanisms, and proposed interventions from three sources. Its fixed 13-signature framing is not reconciled to the current 66-condition candidate and no versioned machine-readable dataset supports an exact network or matrix.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Publish a versioned cross-signature dataset with canonical taxon and condition identifiers, inclusion rules, direction, effect measure, evidence tier, source-level provenance, conflict handling, update date, and accessible table before generating a visualization.

routeDecisions.reason: The route is a source-free structural navigation record with historical counts and product-relationship statements rather than one scientific subject. Its 1,426-source, 130-entity, 19-metal, 83-microbe, and 28-disease numbers do not describe the current governed candidate.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Regenerate the overview from current canonical registries and approved organization/product language, use live accessible counters and navigation components, and do not assign a scientific primary image unless a bounded cited subject is selected.

assets.proposedAlt: Single heavy-atom connectivity model of serotonin with ten carbon, two nitrogen, and one oxygen center.
assets.proposedCaption: Heavy-atom connectivity orientation for neutral serotonin. Hydrogens, physiological protonation state, measured conformation, formulation, concentration, receptor binding, signaling, treatment, behavior, and disease claims are intentionally omitted; this is an educational reconstruction.
assets.proposedDescription: WikiBiome chemical-identity teaching reconstruction of one neutral serotonin heavy-atom model on a pale cool field.
